newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Tractebel announcement after bourse close.
newsitem.headline: Tractebel announcement after bourse close.

text.p: Belgian utility holding company Tractebel said on Thursday it would announce the results of its board of directors' meeting after the 1530 GMT bourse close.
"Tractebel will release a press statement once the bourse closes," spokesman Jacques Van Hee told Reuters.
Rumours have been circulating on the Brussels bourse that the board would decide on Thursday whether to fully merge Tractebel with its unit Powerfin which focuses on foreign energy markets.
The merger would give Tractebel, which now owns about 60 percent of Powerfin, all Powerfin earnings and complete access to Powerfin's international market share.

Powerfin was set up to spearhead Tractebel's expansion drive in the electricity sector abroad. In Belgium Tractebel's role as the main shareholder in Electrabel gives it a virtual monopoly in energy production.
The Powerfin freefloat was valued at about 38 billion Belgian francs this summer.
A weekend report in Belgian financial daily De Financieel- Economische Tijd said the terms of exchange would be 3:1.
This would value one Powerfin share at 4,842 Belgian francs, a slender 1.3 percent premium over its 4,780 franc market price at 1315 GMT on Thursday.
Powerfin shares have been rising since January 1995 when they stood at 2,800 francs.
In the year to date Powerfin rose by some 25 percent, the bourse's Bel-20 index gained about 20 percent.
Tractebel shares stood at 14,525 francs. By contrast, the stock has underperformed the bourse index, gaining only about 17 percent in the year to date.
